instructions: hubzz-bot-mcp is the MCP server that spawns and drives bots in Hubzz worlds over the game WebSocket. Protocol contracts are recorded in russfranky/drift notes/hubzz-contracts/bot-mcp.md (read via context.repos). Org rules hubzz-r1..r4 also apply.

rules.rule: Game frames are delimited by U+F8FF (DELIMITER). Do not replace the delimiter or parse a raw WebSocket payload as a single JSON message. Source: russfranky/drift notes/hubzz-contracts/bot-mcp.md (bot-mcp/term|protocol|delimiter-u-f8ff, bot-mcp/trap|protocol|raw-json-assumption): "Do not replace the delimiter without updating the game server protocol."

Bot authentication is required. Do not make HUBZZ_BOT_TOKEN optional or bypass the token check for normal/production bot sessions, and do not send the token to non-allowlisted wsUrls. Source: russfranky/drift notes/hubzz-contracts/bot-mcp.md (bot-mcp/trap|connection|token-env): "Do not bypass HUBZZ_BOT_TOKEN checks for production bot sessions."

Do not mark a connection ready before acc:ok handling completes. Source: russfranky/drift notes/hubzz-contracts/bot-mcp.md (bot-mcp/decision|connection|login-sequence): "Do not mark connections ready before acc:ok handling completes."

Keep the MAX_* observation buffer caps (chat, events, errors, notices, latencies). Source: russfranky/drift notes/hubzz-contracts/bot-mcp.md (bot-mcp/contract|buffers|chat-event-caps): "Do not remove buffer limits on long-running bot sessions."
